conf.description: Symantec ProxySG / Edge SWG access-main / syslog-csv: thin pass-through, parsing deferred to Elastic (elastic-integration).

conf.comment: symantec-proxysg / access-main / syslog-csv. Parsing is deliberately NOT implemented here: the Elastic integration is the parser downstream (elastic/integrations proxysg, data stream log). Re-implementing that parsing in Cribl would fight it and yield duplicate or conflicting fields, so this pipeline only identifies the event and tags event.dataset, then passes _raw through unmodified. Direct route (no cross-domain guard hop).
